name: bonus-both-v1
description: ⭐ 09/09/2026: STILL A REAL ARM AND A BETTER ONE. Under the commons a bonus IS a card played onto a central board, so bonusSlotsPerTurn 2 is exactly 'every seat holds A Helping Hand' - the card's own commons retext is "you may play a second card onto a central board this turn" (C8). ⚠️ IT IS ALSO THE CRUDEST DIAL ON DEAN'S 30-60% BONUS BAND: it raises the ceiling on the rate rather than the appetite for it, so read it against the band and not as a generosity question. The v31 reading below - two options, one of each - is what it meant while the slot held two different things. EVERY SEAT PLAYS AS IF IT HELD A HELPING HAND (04/09/2026, Dean's visit question). Two bonus slots a turn, one of each option: the free Draw 1 AND a card on a Notice Board. The visit then costs the visitor nothing relative to the solitaire option (give one card, draw one back) instead of the two-card swing it costs today, and it is a strict superset of Draw 1 whenever any open door does anything. This is the cheapest test of 'fix the visit side' that exists as a knob. READ FIRST: the hook (rival visits per turn) and the self-visit share, because the bundle makes self-visiting free too and the clog is its only brake. Then action inflation and game length, then the door clog and denial at 2 seats. If rival visits climb and self-visits climb faster, the bundle needs 'a neighbour's board' written into it.
